## Functions

### `createParticleKinematicsStateContainer(registry, encodedPage, options = {})`

Pack an already encoded page into the versioned ParticleStateEnvelope ABI. The core block contains header + padded base lane; the exception block and caller-supplied layout blocks retain independent byte accounting.

### `readParticleKinematicsStateContainer(registry, envelopeInput, payloadInput)`

Validate and unpack a page envelope. Any byte, count, or sidecar mismatch fails closed.

### `bindParticleKinematicsPageStateCodec(registry)`

Bind the real 8/12-byte page codec to the default packet state layout.

### `createParticleKinematicsPageStateRegistry(options = {})`

Create a default ParticleStateLayoutRegistry with the page codec attached.
